_comment: Gate 4 v2 target table. Copy this file, then check every position against the phone's CURRENT Home screen before calibrating: layouts differ between phones and change when apps move.
C24C positions were read from its Home screen on 1 Oct 2026 (500x1080 mirror, page one).

Targets were chosen to be safe to open repeatedly: nothing that can place a call, send a message, buy or pay, open the camera or personal photos. Live content (Clock, Maps, Podcasts, Safari, Tips, News) is avoided because it never settles into a fixed picture.
Each enabled phone needs at least 6 targets spanning 3 of 4 columns and 3 of 5 rows. The plan needs total / phones to divide by (targets x 5 categories).
C241 is the operator's own phone and stays disabled unless the operator says otherwise.
